title: Hard object found in nostril during 2001 nasal surgery

tellings.quote: Well, uh, in 2001, I believe it was, um, I was having breathing problems. I had a deviated septum. So, I finally had some nasal surgery.

plain: Richard Barth, a former guard at a nuclear missile site who says he was taken by aliens, says that around 2001 he had nasal surgery for a deviated septum that made breathing hard, and a hard object was found in his nostril. He tells it as his own experience. He raises it because it might be a physical trace linked to his abduction.
